not_validated: No person has installed or used 1.1.0 on a real Windows PC; only the GitHub windows-latest runner installed it silently, ran --smoke and the start-up probe, and uninstalled it.

Mica and Acrylic were never seen on a real Windows 11 desktop; the CI runner is Windows Server 2025 without a visible session. A black or opaque window surface on some GPUs or drivers is possible and was not checked.
The full-screen player, the taskbar thumbnail buttons and the cover peek were not checked by a person.
Ketmix Studio was not used with a mouse by a person, and no sound from its preview was heard.
Preset sync between a real phone and Windows through the live account was not tried.
Voice separation ahead on mains power was not run on real downloads on Windows.
Direct3D with vsync was not checked on real GPUs; frame times were not measured.
Memory use was measured in MemoryBudgetTest on the host, not over a long session on Windows.
No faster start was measured on Windows (see startup_measurement).
Upgrading a real 1.0.0 installation to 1.1.0 (MSI major upgrade or the in-app updater) was not tried.
The MSI is not code-signed; Windows SmartScreen will warn about an unknown publisher.
known_limitations: Library pre-separation follows the phone's rules only on mains power; streaming separation ahead of the playhead is not ported to Windows.
Ketmix bar loop is not on Windows yet.
The phone is only reachable for phone control while its app is open or playing.

features_1_1.glass: DWM Mica (DWMWA_SYSTEMBACKDROP_TYPE, or the 21H2 attribute) behind a transparent skiko layer, in-app Acrylic sidebar and bar; solid colours on Windows 10, with transparency off, in high contrast, with the setting off or on any DWM failure
features_1_1.full_screen_player: F11 or the player's button, Esc to leave; cover or Canvas edge to edge with Cascade lyrics
features_1_1.thumbnail_toolbar: ITaskbarList3 in ketvoice_smtc.dll: previous, play/pause, next and the cover as iconic thumbnail; --smoke checks the exports
features_1_1.ketmix_studio: shared automix editor code (MixEditor, MixStudio), presets in ketmix-presets-v1 synced through the account settings document (add-only adoption), KM1. codes, preview through the desktop mixer
features_1_1.voices_ahead: downloads separated ahead on mains power (StemLibrary rules: 300 titles, quick model first)
features_1_1.rendering: Direct3D with vsync on Windows; skiko falls back to OpenGL, then software; the API that draws is logged
features_1_1.memory: covers bounded by bytes (160 MB), decoded at most 1280 px; G1 -Xms64m -Xmx1536m with tight free ratios and periodic GC; MemoryBudgetTest
features_1_1.class_data_sharing: jlink base archive plus an app archive the launcher writes in <install root>\Data\ketvoice.jsa (AutoCreateSharedArchive through jvmArgs)

startup_measurement.finding: the archive is written and mapped (cds log shows the dynamic regions), but on the warm CI runner the time to the first frame does not change beyond run-to-run noise; no faster start is claimed in the release notes
startup_measurement.linux_headless_local: first frame 4842 ms on the run that wrote the archive, then 1714 and 1878 ms with it (software rendering, cold file cache on the first run, so not a clean comparison)
